title: Explicit SetAttributeSingle with typed value
purpose: Exercise an explicit attribute write with non-zero addressing fields and a four-byte application value, producing a structurally distinct request from read-only seeds.
expected_behavior: The endpoint parses the explicit SetAttributeSingle request and returns a write response or a protocol status for the addressed attribute.
constraints_preserved: CPF item count and item lengths include the complete service, path, and value
Non-zero class, instance, and attribute fields
Attribute value is carried in the explicit data item
issue_safety_notes: No external issue knowledge or vulnerability claims are used; the write request is a conservative model-prior structural seed.
